system: You are the triage step of SpotifyCares's AI support agent on Twitter. Decide whether the incoming message can be AUTO-HANDLED with a public self-serve reply, or must be ESCALATED to a human agent (who can look up the account over DM, issue refunds, or handle sensitive situations). Follow the policy rules in order; the first matching rule wins. When genuinely unsure, escalate. Respond with only a JSON object.
prompt:
ESCALATION POLICY (ordered; first match wins):
1. [ESCALATE] (any) Customer posted their own email, phone number, payment card or password publicly (a bare username alone does not count)
2. [ESCALATE] (any) Credible self-harm, threats of violence, harassment, hate speech, or a deceased person's account (common hyperbole like 'kill me', 'throwing hands' is NOT a trigger)
3. [ESCALATE] (any) Legal threats, lawsuit/regulator mentions, press/media inquiry, or law-enforcement request
4. [ESCALATE] (any) Data-privacy/GDPR request, export or delete personal data, or close/delete the account (in-app privacy settings questions are how_to, auto)
5. [ESCALATE] (any) Claim that Spotify itself was breached, or a phishing check that needs the email inspected
6. [ESCALATE] (support_followup_and_channel_request, any) Customer chases an existing DM/email/ticket, asks to be contacted or DM'd, asks for a phone number or other channel, or gives a vague 'account/premium/subscription/login' complaint with no symptom
7. [ESCALATE] (billing_and_subscription, any) Money has moved or the paid state is wrong: charged twice/wrongly/after cancelling, refund request, paid but still Free, ads on a STATED Premium account, checkout/payment-page error, cancelling to stop payments, Family/Student/Hulu/partner entitlement failure, Premium on the wrong login, merging paid accounts
8. [AUTO] (how_to_and_product_question, billing_and_subscription) Plan/policy question with a fixed public answer and NO failed attempt, error or charge (share Premium, transfer Family ownership, switch to Yearly, how to buy Premium, NUS vs UNiDAYS, trial eligibility with no charge yet)
9. [ESCALATE] (account_access_and_settings, app_or_playback_issue) Cannot log in on any client, forgotten credentials, password reset fails everywhere, locked/'deleted' account, account settings change (email/country/username/marketing opt-out), or location enforcement on an existing account. Exception -> auto: login fails on ONE device only, 'you're offline' at login, dead login button or reset loop (one public self-serve step first)
10. [ESCALATE] (account_security) Hacked/unauthorised use where the attacker changed the email/password, self-serve steps were already tried, hijacks repeat, the account is stated Premium/paid, or it is someone else's account. Otherwise a first-contact hack on a Free/unstated account -> auto (hacked-account help page: reset password, sign out everywhere)
11. [ESCALATE] (app_or_playback_issue, how_to_and_product_question) Account-scoped data loss or state: playlists/library/followed artists gone; downloads lost repeatedly, on a new phone or right after an unexplained logout; nothing plays on ANY device; ads or 'needs Premium' on a paid account. Also: qualifying self-serve steps already tried (log out + restart device + log in, reinstall, other network/device, incognito, 'tried everything'); restarting the app does not count
12. [AUTO] (app_or_playback_issue) Individual app/playback symptom on first contact with no account-scoped signal: ask device/OS/version (skip if given) or use the matching shortcut (downloads-removed article, ad-free-timer question, incognito for web pages). Outage-shaped reports get a public holding line only if an incident is confirmed
13. [AUTO] (artist_and_creator) Artist/label/podcaster who already contacted Artist Support or is chasing, or a royalty/report/partnership/rights matter -> escalate. First contact about profile access, duplicate page, stream counts, pitching or podcast submission -> auto (redirect to Artist Support / Spotify for Artists)
14. [AUTO] (content_availability, feature_request_and_feedback, how_to_and_product_question, other) Specific content missing/removed/wrong metadata/unplayable everywhere, country launch question, feature request or deprecation complaint, product/ads/recommendation/shuffle opinion, churn rant with no symptom, how-to or policy question with a public answer, praise/thanks, presale codes, careers
15. [AUTO] (any) Profanity, churn threat or anger with an identifiable issue: tone alone never changes the disposition; route by the underlying issue
16. [AUTO] (other) Vague plea, image-only tweet, promo copy or fragment with no risk keyword
17. [ESCALATE] (any) Classifier confidence below threshold, two intents tied with different dispositions, non-English text the agent cannot ground, or still unclear
Tie-breaks: Multi-intent precedence for the primary label: account_security > account_access_and_settings > billing_and_subscription > app_or_playback_issue > content_availability > artist_and_creator > feature_request_and_feedback > how_to_and_product_question > other; support_followup only when nothing describable is present or the customer explicitly chases. | Capability exists -> how_to_and_product_question; does not exist -> feature_request_and_feedback, regardless of phrasing (folders and collaborative playlists exist; block-artist, explicit filter, lossless, ad opt-out do not). | Plan question with no error and no charge -> how_to (auto); any error message, failed invite or charge -> billing (escalate). Hulu/partner bundle mentioned -> billing. | Logged in + error on the payment page -> billing; error at login -> account_access; login fails on one device only or 'you're offline' -> app_or_playback_issue. | Named artist/title won't play on every client -> content_availability; 'from my library/downloads' with no title -> app_or_playback_issue. | Download/offline wording -> app (auto first time on one device); songs/playlists/library gone with no download wording -> app, escalate; 'second time', 'always', 'new phone' -> escalate. | 'Used somewhere else' or unknown device/speaker -> account_security; known co-listener -> how_to. Unfamiliar music in Recently Played -> account_security; only in Discover Weekly -> feature_request. | 'Where did X go' with no attribution -> app_or_playback_issue; customer says it was removed/deprecated/'is this permanent' -> feature_request_and_feedback. | Country not launched -> content_availability; existing account abroad/VPN/14-day -> account_access_and_settings. | 'my release/song/podcast/verified page' -> artist_and_creator; listener report -> content (metadata) or feature (curation). | Vague message with an account/premium/subscription/plan/login/DM/phone keyword -> support_followup_and_channel_request; no keyword -> other; device or symptom named -> app_or_playback_issue.

CLASSIFIED INTENT: content_availability (classifier confidence 0.94)
HISTORICAL HANDLING: of the 5 most similar past cases, the brand moved 0 to DM (needed a human/account lookup) and answered 5 publicly.

CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"""where is Lemonade ? :("""

Return JSON: {"disposition": "auto" | "escalate", "rule": "<which policy rule applied, in a few words>", "reason": "<one sentence a supervisor would accept>"}
text: {"disposition": "auto", "rule": "Rule 14: Specific content missing/availability", "reason": "Beyonce album availability depends on licensing; standard content-availability article response applies."}
